comment: Add auth.popupRelayUri config + a popup-relay sub-export (runPopupRelay) to acquire tokens via acquireTokenPopup from inside an untrusted cross-origin iframe (storage-partitioned / COOP), relaying the interactive flow through a top-level same-origin page. Supports the auth-code (GET), form_post, and EAR response modes. [#8687](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8687)
